Subject: Project Timeline Update: New Delivery Date

Dear [Client Name],

I want to give you a clear update on the project timeline. The third-party integration required for this phase took longer to certify than the vendor originally indicated, which has pushed our schedule out by two weeks. We have been in close contact with the vendor throughout this process to keep the delay as short as possible.

Based on the certification timeline now confirmed, we are targeting a new delivery date of 14 April. Our team is adjusting the remaining workstreams to make sure quality is not affected by the compressed schedule, and we will continue monitoring the vendor's certification status closely.

Does the 14 April date work with your internal planning, or are there dependencies on your end we should factor in? We will keep you posted on our progress and flag immediately if anything changes. Thank you for your continued partnership on this project.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
